title: Varicose
summary: VAR'ICOSE, VAR'ICOUS, adjective [Latin varicosus, having enlarged veins.] 1. Preternaturally enlarged, or permanently dilated, as a vein. 2. Swelled; puffy; as an ulcer on the legs of beasts.
